replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I’ve always struggled with math. It feels abstract and confusing, which frustrates me because I prefer concrete subjects like physics. My education didn’t focus on it, so I avoid it when possible.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, often. The complexity and lack of intuition make me anxious. Even thinking about equations gives me a headache, so I tend to procrastinate on anything math-related.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven’t. The idea of using AI for math makes me more anxious because I’d worry about not understanding it properly, and I’d rather not deal with the subject at all.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding orthogonal axes of variance. You standardize data, compute covariance, find eigenvalues, and project. replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs could explain concepts step-by-step, but since I dislike math, I’m not sure how it’d help. Maybe by breaking it down in simpler terms, but math isn’t about intuition—it’s about rules, which is why I find it hard.
